facts.current: A week of sitting at a desk

plans.text: Establish a consistent morning routine on weekends.
Incorporate yoga or stretching on Sundays to loosen up after a week of sitting at a desk.
Read for 30 minutes each night before bed, starting with "The Lean Startup" and applying its principles to their own projects.
Check online route-finding tools for a suitable jogging route.
Check online for water fountains or drinking water stations along the jogging route.
Find a jogging route with some shade and check for water fountains along the way.
Leave earbuds behind and focus on their surroundings during the jog.

superseded_plans.text: Read more before bed each night.

preferences.text: Likes sleeping in a bit later on weekends.
Likes the idea of doing yoga or stretching.
Likes the idea of starting small and scaling up as they become more comfortable with the practice.
Likes the idea of building and launching successful startups.
Is curious to learn more about Eric Ries's startup framework and sees "The Lean Startup" as a good starting point.
Prefers jogging routes that are relatively flat and have some shade.
